debit.notes: Customer Care Centre runs 24/7 on toll-free 1800-425-1747 and chargeable line 044 42413000; the debit-card IVR menu is language -> account related -> savings/current -> 1 block / 2 temporary unblock. number2 is not a call line: the bank publishes a missed-call self-service — give a missed call from your registered mobile to +91-88-93553553 to disable/enable all debit cards on that number, confirmed by SMS. Website: on www.dhan.bank.in use the pre-login Retail Banking 'Block Card -> Debit Card' flow or, after login, Menu -> Block/Unblock & PIN Generation -> Card block (Debit/Credit); the bank's site nav carries a dedicated 'Card Block (Debit/Credit)' link to delight.dhan.bank.in/ib-retail-web/userProfile/cardBlock. DhanSmart app / DhanDelight retail netbanking menu path for a permanent hotlist: Services -> Debit Cards -> Select Card -> Hot list (temporary block/unblock: Services -> Debit Cards -> Select Card -> Block/Unblock Card). Fraudulent-transaction reports may also be emailed to support@dhanbank.co.in (that address is for fraud reports only). No SMS hotlist keyword exists for cards — the bank's SMS keywords BLOCKUPI / BLOCKIBMB to 918105754333 block only the UPI and mobile/netbanking channels. No overseas hotline is published. The bank's own page additionally directs fraud complaints to the MHA cyber helpline 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.

credit.notes: Credit-card blocking goes through the same 24/7 Customer Care Centre (toll-free 1800-425-1747, chargeable 044 42413000); no missed-call or SMS self-service is published for credit cards. Website: on www.dhan.bank.in use the pre-login Retail Banking 'Block Card -> Credit Card' flow or, after login, Menu -> Block/Unblock & PIN Generation -> Card block (Debit/Credit); the bank's site nav carries a dedicated 'Card Block (Debit/Credit)' link to delight.dhan.bank.in/ib-retail-web/userProfile/cardBlock. DhanSmart app / DhanDelight netbanking menu path for a permanent hotlist: Services -> Credit Cards -> Card Hot listing (temporary block/unblock: Services -> Credit Cards -> Block/Unblock Cards). Fraudulent-transaction reports may also be emailed to support@dhanbank.co.in (fraud reports only), and the bank's own page directs fraud complaints additionally to the MHA cyber helpline 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in. No overseas hotline is published.
